subject.title: fix(signal): expose mention facts in inbound context

question: Should OpenClaw accept `CanDetectMention`, `HasAnyMention`, `EffectiveWasMentioned`, `MentionShouldSkip`, and `MentionSource: "native"` as public inbound context/plugin SDK contract surface in this stacked Signal change?
rationale: The implementation is additive and tested, but these context fields become integration surface after release and the stacked prerequisite changes Signal mention-gated group delivery behavior.

options.title: Accept After Prerequisite
options.body: Merge or rebase after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96738, then accept these names as the public mention-facts context contract.

options.title: Narrow To Signal Diagnostics
options.body: Keep the native Signal gating fix but avoid generic SDK context fields until a broader channel-context naming pass settles the permanent API.

options.title: Defer API Surface
options.body: Pause this PR and move the context contract into a separate maintainer-sponsored channel/plugin SDK design pass.

recommendation.title: Accept After Prerequisite
recommendation.body: Merge or rebase after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96738, then accept these names as the public mention-facts context contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily shared mention-policy and plugin SDK context contract shape, and history points most strongly to this owner for that area.
